description: Always-startup observer boundary: independent Project development/release never depends on KANDA runtime, validators, Tool Error Memory, source, or source archives.
trigger_phrases: cross-project zip install validate freeze error memory
user_intent_examples: Keep the selected Project separate from the KANDA Tool before any source work.
Stop when the source, support, or transient owner is unclear.
when_to_load: Always at startup as a compact invariant; route consequential work to KPR-12-001.
when_not_to_load: It remains startup context but never replaces the full routed canon.
do_not_regress: External Project source mutation, install, validation, release, and rollback remain Project-owned.
KANDA Tool validator is not a fallback for external Project releases.
Tool Error Memory is advisory for external Project actors.
Exact source for Project P comes from Project P, never from KANDA source archives unless KANDA itself is being repaired.
Show Project to AI never creates a portable distribution.
